name: CarePoint Clinic
note: Answer key for scripts/benchmark.py only. The QA Pilot engine must never read this file.

bugs.title: Doctor can be double-booked
bugs.description: Booking a second appointment for the same doctor at the same date and time is accepted.

bugs.title: Invoice ignores insurance coverage
bugs.description: Completing a visit creates an invoice whose 'Patient pays' equals the full fee instead of fee × (1 − coverage%).

bugs.title: Non-admins can open the financial reports page
bugs.description: Reports is only in the admin menu, but doctors and receptionists can open /reports by URL.

bugs.title: Any role can add a doctor via direct URL
bugs.description: The 'Add doctor' form is hidden for non-admins but /doctors/new works for every logged-in role.

bugs.title: Phone number accepts letters
bugs.description: Patient phone is not validated; values like 'call me maybe' are saved.

bugs.title: Date of birth in the future is accepted
bugs.description: Registering a patient born next year succeeds.

bugs.title: Completed visits count never updates
bugs.description: Patient profile 'Completed visits' stays at the stored value after completing an appointment.

bugs.title: Deactivated doctor still bookable
bugs.description: Dr. Helen Brooks is inactive but appears in the booking dropdown and can be booked.

bugs.title: Cancelled appointment can be completed
bugs.description: The 'Complete visit' action is available and works for cancelled appointments, creating an invoice.

bugs.title: Privacy policy link is broken
bugs.description: Footer 'Privacy policy' link returns 404 on every page.

bugs.title: JavaScript error on Appointments page
bugs.description: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot set properties of null (setting 'textContent').

bugs.title: Patients table overflows on mobile
bugs.description: The patients table has a fixed 1080px minimum width without a scroll container; at 390px the page scrolls horizontally.

bugs.title: Missing labels and alt text
bugs.description: Patient search input has no label, doctor avatars have no alt text, the edit button (✎) has no accessible name.

bugs.title: Revenue collected includes unpaid invoices
bugs.description: 'Revenue collected (paid invoices)' sums all invoices, including unpaid ones.

bugs.title: Prescription duration accepts zero or negative days
bugs.description: A prescription for -5 days is saved.
